blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The General Appropriations Acts (GAAs) for 2024 and 2025 will go down in history as the worst budgets approved by Congress, Sen. Panfilo Lacson declared on Wednesday. This came after the Supreme Court (SC) ruled on Tuesday that some provisions in the 2024 and 2025 GAAs were unconstitutional. “The 2024 and 2025 GAAs will go down in history as the worst budgets ever passed by Congress,” Lacson said in a statement. With both fiscal years having already ended, Lacson surmised that funds that “remain unspent may not be disbursed anymore,” while those already utilized “may not be invalidated.” […]...
